item.title: Elgin Academy Pupils Share Burns Night Message of Hope With Ukrainian School
item.description: Elgin Academy pupils have shared a Burns Night message of friendship with a partner school in Ukraine, using poetry and music to show solidarity and support for young people learning under the strain of ongoing conflict.The post Elgin Academy Pupils Share Burns Night Message of Hope With Ukrainian School appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Inverness International Blues Festival Unveils Big Top and New Promo Video
item.description: Inverness is preparing for a major musical moment as the Inverness International Blues Festival confirms a Big Top venue and releases a new promo video ahead of its debut event, bringing world class blues artists to the city this March.The post Inverness International Blues Festival Unveils Big Top and New Promo Video appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Eight Days Left Before Self Assessment Penalties Begin
item.description: With eight days left before the Self Assessment deadline, HMRC is urging millions of taxpayers to file now to avoid penalties, warning that fines apply even when no tax is owed and highlighting support available for those yet to submit.The post Eight Days Left Before Self Assessment Penalties Begin appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: A9 Traffic Delays Expected During Sunday Morning Works
item.description: Drivers on the A9 are being warned of short delays on Sunday 8 February as Transport Scotland carries out early morning works linked to the A9 Dualling project, with temporary traffic signals in place for brief periods.The post A9 Traffic Delays Expected During Sunday Morning Works appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: New Support Facility Opens Doors for Pupils at Wick High School
item.description: A new additional support needs facility has opened at Wick High School, with the repurposed Avonlea building providing specialist classrooms, multi sensory spaces and secure outdoor areas designed to support pupils with complex needs across Caithness.The post New Support Facility Opens Doors for Pupils at Wick High School appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Cold and Unsettled Weather Continues Across Highlands and Islands
item.description: Unsettled weather is set to continue across the Highlands and Islands, with heavy rain, strong winds and snow forecast over higher ground as colder air moves in, prompting weather warnings and difficult conditions on exposed routes.The post Cold and Unsettled Weather Continues Across Highlands and Islands appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Indian Motorcycle Revives a Classic With New Chief Vintage
item.description: Indian Motorcycle has unveiled the 2026 Chief Vintage, blending 1940s inspired design with modern performance and technology as part of its 125th anniversary, offering a heritage styled cruiser aimed at riders who value comfort, torque and character on long Scottish roads.The post Indian Motorcycle Revives a Classic With New Chief Vintage appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Is Trump America’s First Presidential Dictator and Did His Roots Shape The Man
item.description: Donald Trump’s governing style, shaped by deal making culture and personal power, is raising serious questions about democratic limits, with a Highland connection adding an unexpected lens on whether America is drifting towards presidential rule by decree.The post Is Trump America’s First Presidential Dictator and Did His Roots Shape The Man appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: A Simple Island Home Set in Aywick on Yell
item.description: Set in Aywick on the east side of Yell, Rocklea Cottage is a three bedroom island home with garden space, workshop potential, and room to shape over time, offering a quieter way of living rooted in place.The post A Simple Island Home Set in Aywick on Yell appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: SNP MP Demands Apology From Trump Over NATO War Remarks
item.description: An SNP MP representing key military bases in the Highlands has demanded an apology from Donald Trump after comments questioning NATO allies’ role in Afghanistan, saying the remarks insult the memory of UK service personnel who lost their lives following the invocation of Article 5.The post SNP MP Demands Apology From Trump Over NATO War Remarks appeared first on The Highland Times.
